title: DeedHub
tagline: NFT loan marketplace and aggregator designed for advanced users and traders
description: The project aims to capture various data points in the NFT market in general, including price points in sales market, NFT loan listing in other protocols , and provide the required data analytics so that advanced users can risk-manage their loan positions/listing while gaining considerable income. It also helps to boost for greater liquidity and market size for NFT loans in general.
how_its_made: It captures the data out in the market, including NFT loan platforms, market trading metrics & activities such as OpenSea, Blur and LooksRare, and other useful reference data such as rarity and third-party NFT valuation. With those, interesting data points can be placed together on one screen for users to compare and find the right deals that fit for them. It can also allow placing offers across multiple platforms at the same time, thanks to their permission smart contracts.
